summary: This Secret History lecture is already public-lens pressure: it turns modern scapegoating into a face-for-hidden-power mechanism, ties secular modernity to reason-as-replacement religion, contrasts Marx's object mirror with Bakunin's human mirror, and frames Freud's reversal as psychology protecting power by turning wounds inward.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Empire needs visible middle managers and scapegoats while transnational capital keeps profit and control in shadow.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public read already links this phrase to the Taboo anchor, and the public concept page uses the source as its modern-scapegoat layer.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: If God and truth disappear, utility and matter take over religion's old truth-making and salvation work.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The episode's utility and Marx passages already support the atlas relation for secular substitutes inheriting religion's old work.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The object is not the mirror of freedom; another free person is, and paradise comes through love rather than objects or public property.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Human Heart page already uses this source as the relational-freedom layer, and the episode read links the relevant marks to the same anchor.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep the 2025-12-16 modern-scapegoat layer as the volatile but useful form of scapegoating: a marked intermediary group becomes a visible face for a profit-and-control structure that would otherwise be too abstract to hate.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Taboo owns this when blame is being routed into a marked body. Secret Society owns the hidden coordination layer only when secrecy, membership, initiation, or cross-bureaucratic trust is the active mechanism.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the Bakunin contrast as the heart page's relational-freedom layer: Marx's object mirror cannot replace the recognition of other free people, and inward self-analysis cannot supply meaning, purpose, and love.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Human Heart owns this because the active mechanism is relation as the confirmation of freedom. Power As Alchemy owns the abstract individual and material object when they become reality-commanding substitutions.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Preserve this source as a bridge in the atlas relation: skepticism, utility, Darwinism, Marxist material paradise, and Freudian inwardness are read as modern replacements for truth, God, and relational salvation.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: The atlas relation owns the replacement-religion pattern. The Dead World owns material-only ontology; Human Heart owns the relational counterclaim.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Treat the Freud sequence as secondary evidence for power protecting itself through theory: direct trauma testimony threatens powerful patrons, so the institution can make dreams, fantasy, and inward interpretation overwrite the wound.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power As Alchemy owns the conversion of memory and wound into an institutional reality that protects patrons. Human Heart owns the wound as moral knowledge; Attention Capture owns dream/mind manipulation only if the active mechanism becomes focus capture.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the Disraeli and revolution passages cautiously as attributed evidence for public-face and stateless-capital coordination, preserving Jiang's caveats that the source material is strange rather than proved master-plan doctrine.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Secret Society should not absorb the whole source. Use it only for coordination, membership, public faces, and hidden governance; route blame-transfer to Taboo and debt/asset-stripping to Power As Alchemy or Strategy.

new_lens_seeds.title: Modernity As Scapegoat Machine
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Modern empire can keep the real profit center abstract while assigning visible managerial bodies to absorb anger, then route philosophical, financial, revolutionary, and psychological systems through that blame structure.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism could connect future sources on transnational capital, middlemen, ethnic blame, revolutionary theft, and institutional psychology, but it currently overlaps strongly with Taboo's modern-scapegoat anchor and should not become public unless additional sources prove a broader modernity page is needed.

new_lens_seeds.title: Psychology As Inward Control
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A psychology that begins by hearing wounds can become control when institutional incentives make it reinterpret memory as fantasy, convert trauma into self-accusation, and move the victim's attention inward where the patron is protected.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This may recur across Freud, education, attention, therapy, and elite-protection sources, but the current public surface can hold it as evidence under Power As Alchemy and Human Heart until recurrence proves a standalone concept.

chronology_notes.note: The source is dated 2025-12-16 and sits late in the Secret History arc, after the 2025-12-11 Frankism lecture and before the promised Pax Judaica culmination.
Because public lens pages already cite this source, its impact record should be read as accounting and routing, not as a request to append ordinary new prose to Taboo or Human Heart.

canon_candidates.candidate: Modern scapegoating gives hidden power a face when an empire or capital structure keeps profit and control in shadow while a visible middle-manager group absorbs blame for the system it helps administer.
canon_candidates.promotion_note: Candidate only; the phrase is already a public lens point, but glossary promotion needs review because the source is volatile and must keep Jiang's caveat visible.

canon_candidates.candidate: When truth, God, and relational salvation are displaced, utility, matter, policy math, public property, and psychological inwardness can inherit religion's old work while calling themselves secular.
canon_candidates.promotion_note: Candidate only; compare against the French Revolution and existing atlas-relation sources before any canon promotion.

canon_candidates.candidate: Psychology becomes gaslighting when theory protects the powerful by treating a wound as fantasy, desire, attention-seeking, or resistance to interpretation.
canon_candidates.promotion_note: Candidate only; should be reviewed against the existing Freud passage in Power As Alchemy and any later psychology sources.

next_actions.action: Do not add another ordinary Taboo section from this source; the public page already has the modern-scapegoat layer and durable anchor.
Before promoting psychology-as-inward-control, compare this source with the existing Freud and modernism passage in Power As Alchemy and any future therapy/attention sources.
If Pax Judaica sources are processed next, compare them against this lecture's closing note rather than treating the 2025-12-16 source as a final settled position.
